about: Hand-written layout of one of the two packs of scene.road-river (F-10; ux/scenes/homeward-road.md 1): plan metres, +x = towards Syracuse = azimuth 90° (east), +y = upstream (north), the landing ground at z = 0. Rotation 0, so glTF x = plan x and glTF z = -plan y. The two packs share places, exits and spot names (assets/pipeline/road/merge_river.mjs checks they agree and writes assets/scenes/road-river/scene.json for the backend). Spots marked auto: false are for set pieces only; way.* are the ways out. select: the page loads this pack in that act (road-river/index.json); bridge is var.bridge there, for reference. Act 4, 11:20 to 12:00: the bridge is gone, the river fills both banks; the river bed is not walkable, the drowned road is (1.3).

water.about: plan coordinates (layout.json); the page turns them into glTF. flowDirPlan: downstream; splashPlan: where the flood breaks on the piles and the snag, and the boulders in the shallows (a faint wake, no spray below 0.5) [x, y, strength], at most 12; slowPlan: ellipses [x, y, rx, ry] of slack water (the upstream shallows, the drowned west road); haze: the distance fog against the plaza's (rain-washed air); horizonDeg: how high the hills round the valley stand seen from the water (what it mirrors low down)

walkable.name: west bank and the road, the last 3 m of it under a few centimetres of water
east bank above the flood (reached only through the crossing set piece: navRoots) (the upstream shallows, y 7..18.5, are water: from x = 12 there)
